Subject: MSA + Order Form — EU residency, billing & signer path

Hi Marcus / Aurora team,

Thanks again for the time earlier — excited to move this across the finish line. Attaching our draft MSA and the Order Form exhibit so legal and procurement can do an initial read. High-level asks from our side to speed review:

- Confirm whether Aurora requires onshore (EU) data residency for logs + embeddings output; if yes, please highlight which countries/regions are mandatory.
- Provide the preferred signer/authority matrix (we usually need a billing sig + legal sig). If you can attach that matrix it will help map the signature blocks.
- Any non-standard billing terms (VAT handling, invoicing cadence, PO requirements)?

Attachments: Aurora_MSA_Draft_v1.docx, OrderForm_ExhibitA.xlsx

Proposed timeline: initial redlines back by 2026-12-04 so we can resolve open items in the week of 12/6. If you need a short working session to walk exhibits and residency options we can schedule 30m.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt

From: Marcus Holt <m.holt@aurorahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurora Health Procurement <procurement@aurorahealth.com>, Legal <legal@aurorahealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T18:04:00Z
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form — EU residency, billing & signer path

Hannah — thanks for the materials. Quick clarifying points from Aurora Legal / Procurement: 

1) Data residency: Aurora requires logs and any PII-derived artifacts to remain in the EU for EU-resident patients. We operate primarily from Ireland and Germany; either is acceptable but needs to be explicit in the MSA (region-level, not just "EU"). Can you confirm Redwood's ability to warranty residency in eu-west-1/ie-west/Germany (we can provide region list).

2) Billing: Procurement needs to know whether Redwood will issue invoices with VAT shown separately. Also whether Redwood can accept PO numbers on invoices and a 45-day net term instead of your standard 30. 

3) Signer matrix: attaching our standard signature matrix to show two signers required (Legal + Finance). Also note that for larger deals Aurora sometimes requires countersignature by a regional subsidiary — we'll flag if that applies.

Attaching: Aurora_signature_matrix.pdf

We should also align on SOC2 / security evidence. Can you send a link to your current SOC2 report and the contact for a security questionnaire?

Marcus Holt
Senior Counsel, Aurora Health
m.holt@aurorahealth.com

Onward — happy to jump on a 30m call if helpful.

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Holt <m.holt@aurorahealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form — EU residency, billing & signer path

Marcus / team — thanks for the clear asks. A few notes from Security & Contracts ops: 

- Residency: Redwood can offer region-specific hosting for logs and embeddings on our Private/DEDicated offering and for Hosted customers we can pin to eu-west-1 (Ireland) for this workload. We'll include a residency clause that enumerates the acceptable regions (ie, "eu-west-1 / eu-central-1") and reference our data processing addendum. If Aurora needs a warranty to a specific country-level data center, we can discuss a supplemental exhibit.

- SOC2 and evidence: SOC2 report and current pen-test summary are available here: https://drive.reddemo.com/shared/aurora-evidence-pack. I'll add the security questionnaire owner (cs-security@redwood.com) to the thread if you want direct Q/A.

- Billing: We can present invoices with VAT shown separately. Regarding net terms, we generally operate 30 net for new logos but can make an exception to 45 days with Finance approval on a deal commit. Laura can pick up PO and invoicing cadence.

Action items I will take: prepare a short redline summary (highlighting residency clause options + SOC2 link) and propose a canary hosting note for the Order Form to limit residency scope initially. Target to send that summary tomorrow morning.

Kimberly Park
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form — EU residency, billing & signer path

Marcus / Aurora team — circling up with next steps and a short timeline so procurement and legal have clarity: 

1) Redwood will provide a redline summary PDF that calls out two options for residency language: (A) pin to eu-west-1 (Ireland) for all logs + embeddings; (B) country-specific warranty with a limited support SLA impact. Kimberly will attach that summary (redline_summary_hs_20261203.pdf) and propose exact clause wording by EOD 12/03.

2) SOC2 / evidence: Kimberly confirmed the Drive link above; I'll also share a limited-view DocuSign access for your procurement review if helpful (DocuSign link in related links).

3) Billing / PO: Laura will coordinate with Aurora Procurement on VAT invoicing and PO placement. Laura — can you confirm whether Finance will approve a one-time 45 day net extension if Procurement requests it?

4) Signatures: if Aurora requires a regional subsidiary countersign, please flag immediately so we can route exhibits appropriately.

Proposed next touchpoints:
- 12/03: Redwood posts redline summary and proposed clause edits (Kimberly)
- 12/04: Aurora returns high-level redline comments or requests a 30m working call
- 12/09: Target for fully aligned MSA + signed Order Form (subject to countersign logistics)

If a call is easier, I'm available 12/03 16:00–17:30 CET.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt

Redwood Inference
